en: A vintage postcard depicting a central European small town street scene with old-style buildings, half-timbered houses, a stone railing, a visible archway leading to an inner courtyard, and surrounding forested hills. The street is curving and bordered by buildings, one of which has the German word 'Gasthof' (inn) painted on the side. The top of the card has red printed German text indicating the location and the viewpoint towards the market and castle entrance.
